textLocation: Claude project only (holdout/PHASE-2B-HOLDOUT.md). Not in this repository until the exit check.
use: Phase 2b exit check only, 6 cases x 3 runs. Exposed after use.

hashMethod.file: SHA-256 of the UTF-8, LF-terminated YAML block, header comments included, {DATE} unfilled.
hashMethod.case: Split on lines consisting exactly of '---'; strip leading/trailing newlines, append one LF, SHA-256.

dateRule: {DATE} = the case weekday 7-14 days after the exit check starts. Filling the date and switching to the listed fallback place if witness certification fails are the only permitted changes; both are recorded.
